source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Do not invent single-stock closes when fresh independent sources conflict or are still intraday. Those fields remain null and may be filled only by same-date GitHub validation.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. unveils tougher Iran sanctions while oil falls
breaking_news.summary: Washington announced a harder sanctions push on Iran-linked activity. Despite the geopolitical escalation, WTI fell about 2.3% Monday, helping Treasury yields ease.
breaking_news.market_impact: Lower oil and yields cushioned equities, but sanctions keep energy and inflation risk alive.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Watch energy/shipping volatility and valuation sensitivity in high-multiple technology.

breaking_news.headline: Canada trade tensions escalate after U.S. signals 50% auto tariffs
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. threatened sharply higher tariffs on Canadian automotive imports after talks deteriorated.
breaking_news.market_impact: Supported some U.S. steel names but raised trade-policy uncertainty.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Monitor auto parts, metals and broader export-risk sentiment.

breaking_news.headline: Technology and semiconductors lead Monday selloff
breaking_news.summary: The Nasdaq fell 0.76% and SOX dropped 3.42% while the Dow rose 0.26%, showing a clear rotation away from AI hardware and high-duration technology.
breaking_news.market_impact: Breadth is mixed rather than broad risk-off; financials and defensive groups held up better.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Raises near-term caution for AI hardware, memory, PCB and high-beta semiconductor names unless local flows confirm strength.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA expands AI model strategy with Poolside licensing and investment deal
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: NVIDIA agreed to a roughly $6 billion licensing partnership with AI startup Poolside, will hire more than 100 staff, and is investing about $1 billion as it pushes open-weight Nemotron models.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Reinforces NVIDIA's move beyond chips into models and ecosystem financing, but adds capital-allocation scrutiny ahead of earnings.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Structurally supportive for compute demand, though Monday's 2.9% NVDA decline warns that expectations are elevated.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Taiwan prosecutors indict group accused of routing B300 servers to China
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: A senior NVIDIA manager and others were reported indicted in Taiwan over alleged shipment of servers containing high-end B300 chips through Japan and Indonesia to circumvent U.S. restrictions.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Highlights export-control and compliance risk around advanced AI hardware.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Adds regulatory risk for server channels and distribution while underlying AI demand remains strong.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA earnings on Aug. 26 remains the week's largest AI catalyst
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Markets are focused on whether AI infrastructure demand, gross margins and forward guidance can justify high expectations after a semiconductor selloff.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Potentially decisive for semiconductors, hyperscaler capex proxies and broader Nasdaq risk appetite.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Highest sensitivity remains TSMC, CoWoS, AI server ODMs, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

taiwan_market_impact: SOX -3.42% and NVDA -2.91% make U.S. semiconductor weakness the main negative input for Taiwan's Tuesday open.
The Dow's +0.26% versus Nasdaq -0.76% confirms rotation rather than uniform risk-off; use the new U.S. RRG and Taiwan Rotation pages to identify where flows are actually moving.
USD/TWD closed at 31.854 on Aug. 24, slightly weaker TWD, while foreign TX net OI remained deeply short at roughly -82.5k contracts; treat index upside with caution until local breadth/flows improve.
NVIDIA earnings on Aug. 26 and U.S. PCE are the two highest-impact near-term catalysts for Taiwan AI hardware and valuation multiples.
narration_points: 美股週一呈現明顯分化：道瓊上漲0.26%，但標普跌0.28%、那斯達克跌0.76%，資金明顯自高估值科技撤出。
費城半導體指數重挫3.42%至11339點，NVIDIA下跌2.91%，AI硬體是今天台股盤前最大的壓力來源。
十年期美債殖利率回落到4.709%，WTI跌到85美元附近，利率與能源壓力稍降，但伊朗制裁與加拿大關稅仍提高政策不確定性。
NVIDIA週三財報與PCE數據將共同決定本週AI估值與利率方向，台積電、CoWoS、AI Server、網通、PCB、散熱與電源族群需同步觀察。
